_comment: The Cucumber support helpers, scanned at the same 19 tokens as src/ rather than the 48 the rest of test/ gets. They are production-shaped code - one named helper per thing a person does - so near-identical helpers there are the exact merge we want, and 48 was far too loose to see them: the four-way copy of "open a listing's edit form, save, check it saved" sat at 32-37 tokens, and a duplicate BookingChoices/ByHandBooking interface at 25, both unnoticed across several stories. Getting to 0% at 19 took about fifty merges and needed no contortion: import blocks carry the sanctioned jscpd:ignore, the signatures every helper shares became named contracts (ActOnOneThing, ChangeOneThing, ReadAboutOneThing, CheckMoneyShown), and repeated anonymous return types became named interfaces - all of which AGENTS.md asks for anyway. The step files under test/specs/steps stay on the ordinary test/ scan: a Given/When/Then registration is boilerplate that repeats by design, and the shared mechanism IS Cucumber's own registry, the same argument that exempts the migrations. src/ is scanned alongside so a helper that reimplements production logic is flagged against the source it copied - a separate run could never see that. src/ against itself is already held at 0% by .jscpd.json, so nothing new is reported there.
